services.name: The Magic Tour
services.desc: Experience a romantic twilight tour around Orlando! Distance 35 miles Private Tour - $225 Public Tour $199 About A magical tour taking you around the perimeter of the Disney Magic Kingdom! Enjoy the breathtaking view of several beautiful lakes dotting the central Florida landscape and fly past beloved parks and landmarks including Disney Springs, Animal Kingdom, Blizzard Beach, Old Town, ESPN Wide World of Sports, and All-Star Resort - plus much more. An unforgettable view of the best of Orlando! More Info Confirmation will be received at the time of booking. 2 passenger minimum up to 4 Up to Four Passengers • 35 Miles • Private Tours Available! • From $150!
